title: Check: Area of Rectangles and Triangles

questions.stem: A triangle has an area of $24\text{ cm}^2$ and a base of $8\text{ cm}$. What is its perpendicular height?
questions.explanation: Using $A = \frac{1}{2}bh$, we get $24 = \frac{1}{2} \times 8 \times h$, so $24 = 4h$, giving $h = 6\text{ cm}$.
